subject.title: fix(heartbeat): bound HEARTBEAT.md file read size

question: Should user-managed symlinked `HEARTBEAT.md` files remain supported when the read is bounded?
rationale: Current behavior follows the symlink, while this branch silently treats it as missing; repository docs do not establish that rejecting this workspace file form is intentional.

options.title: Preserve symlink compatibility
options.body: Bound the resolved file read while retaining existing symlinked heartbeat behavior and add focused compatibility coverage.

options.title: Intentionally reject symlinks
options.body: Approve the fail-closed behavior explicitly and require visible upgrade documentation, diagnostics, and symlink regression coverage before merge.

recommendation.title: Preserve symlink compatibility
recommendation.body: Bound the resolved file read while retaining existing symlinked heartbeat behavior and add focused compatibility coverage.

likelyOwner.reason: The history connects this person to the original preflight path and multiple later heartbeat integration decisions.
